notes.text:
Cotillion-Vanilla Fudge, BMI. (A1, A2, A4, B1)
Screen Gems-Columbia, BMI. (A3)
United Artists, ASCAP. (B2)
Good Songs, BMI. (B3)

All the arrangements are by Vanilla Fudge with the exception of the fanfare at the beginning of Lord In The Country which was arranged by Charles Morrow.
Recorded at Atlantic Recording Studios, New York
This is a stereo recording. For best results observe the R.I.A.A. high frequency roll-off characteristic with a 500 cycle crossover.
